infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ZuiGO requires camera access for dynamic QR code scanning, facial liveness verification, and field visit photo proofs.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ZuiGO requires location access to verify physical presence inside authorized office premises and client destinations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ZuiGO requires background location access to calculate accurate vehicle mileage and travel route logs during active field shifts.
